facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's proposed 2026 appropriation bill (posted before parliamentary approval) gives the Data Protection Authority (head 030702) US$170,880 recurrent for 2026.
The Data Protection Authority's proposed recurrent budget is US$170,880 for 2026 against US$162,060 for 2025; the page also shows a project line of US$1,826,000 for the prior year.

note: Proposed stage only; the enacted act is catalogued separately. Page holds citation and structure, with only the Data Protection Authority figures.
